summary: Omnitek Engineering Corp filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026, disclosing an Asset Purchase Agreement to sell substantially all assets related to its diesel-to-alternative-fuel technology business to Omnitek Corp., with Werner Funk as Buyer Executive. The deal closed the same day; buyer assumed all related liabilities and contracts. Funk terminated his employment, forgiving $632,273 in back salary and all company debts. No price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The company has pivoted to ready-mix operations after acquiring Hard Rock Ready Mix. Watch for post-sale overhang and new management execution risks.
